needs_you.allow_not_offered: This change isn't what was offered.

needs_you.answer_in_kiff_until: Answering from the phone arrives once KIFF checks the phone's signature. Until then, answer in KIFF.
needs_you.answer_names_each: so the answer names each one.
needs_you.answer_not_taken: KIFF doesn't take your answer to this one.
needs_you.card_unit.changed: This request changed. Read it again before dismissing it.
needs_you.change_limit: Change the limit in Coach mode
needs_you.check_code: Check that KIFF shows the same code, and approve only with this phone in your hands.
needs_you.empty_hint: When a taf asks for something outside its Card, it shows up here and on your lock screen.
needs_you.expired_line: Expired. Nobody answered in time, so KIFF refused it and nothing was sent.
needs_you.get_alert_when_call_waits: Get an alert when a call waits for your answer, even with tafs closed.
needs_you.install_from_card: Install it from its card: the version goes live, then Coach hears.

needs_you.knocks.one: Someone knocked at its door. Nothing was done.
needs_you.knocks.other: {count} knocks at its doors. Nothing was done.

needs_you.know_moment_taf_needs_you: Know the moment a taf needs you
needs_you.no_gives_card_room_back: No gives its Card the room back. Answering asks for {biometry}.

needs_you.over_total_manager: It's over a Card total, such as a day's. Extra room lets only this call through.
needs_you.refused.approver_only: Only an approver answers held calls on this account.
needs_you.refused.card_changer: You changed the Card this was held against, so another approver answers it.
needs_you.refused.check_unavailable: KIFF couldn't check who may answer just now. Try again.
needs_you.refused.role: Your role on this account doesn't answer held calls. Someone who approves on it does.
needs_you.refused.self_review: You asked for this, so someone else on the account approves it. You can still refuse it.
needs_you.refused.signed_in_approver: Held calls are answered by an approver signed in, not by a key.
needs_you.request_taf_missing: That request couldn't be read: its taf isn't on this phone.
needs_you.second_step: Extra room went through. This call is held again for a limit of its own: {reason}. Approve it once to let it go, or refuse it.
needs_you.sign_in_again_to_answer: Sign out and in again to answer from this phone, so KIFF knows its key. Or answer this one in KIFF.
needs_you.someone_answers: Someone who approves on this account answers this. Their answer shows here.
needs_you.title: Needs you
needs_you.when_taf_asks_something_outsid: An alert reaches you on this {device}, even with tafs closed.
needs_you.your_step.ended: This step was already answered or has ended.
